recentItems.title: We Tried EPIC Challenges at a NASCAR Race Track! | Full Episode | LEGO Brick Click
recentItems.description:
Two teams. One speedway. The LEGO® Brick Click takes on NASCAR Iowa Speedway for a head-to-head adventure packed with epic challenges. From navigating a LEGO Technic RC car through a wild obstacle course to racing in the Kids Zone, every stop brings a new challenge to conquer. Plus, NASCAR star Connor Zilisch makes a special appearance! Who will cross the finish line first and dominate this NASCAR Iowa adventure?! 

Welcome back to LEGO Brick Click, now with even more adventures, laughs, and creativity! In this all-new season, our dynamic crew of makers reunite both inside the epic LEGO clubhouse and venture out into the world, where builds are wilder, challenges are bigger, and breaking the rules is half the fun. 

Watch more LEGO Brick Click here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLRNbTEZ7dhL0HGFOYSHLX3D0r0xjoRs4r&si=VyN17DloRmNLBWvl 

Subscribe to the LEGO channel: https://bit.ly/LEGOOfficial
Join the #LEGOBrickClick squad as we dive head first into wild challenges, hilarious belly laughs, unhinged chaos and sometimes an EPIC build. This is the LEGO world like you’ve never seen it before!

0:00-0:50: Welcome to NASCAR Iowa Speedway!
0:51-1:55: Pit Stall Challenge 
1:56-2:44: Red Flag Green Flag Challenge
2:45-3:46: Minifigure Search featuring Connor Zilisch! 
3:47-5:27: Ramp Race 
5:28-5:53: Victory Lap
5:54-7:09: LEGO 350 
7:10-7:57: Who will win?!
